name: Stacks of Wheat (End of Summer)
description: Palette extracted from the public-domain work “Stacks of Wheat (End of Summer)” by Claude Monet (1890–91), Art Institute of Chicago artwork 64818. Adapted for high-contrast GameCore 5.1 UI.
changelog: 1.0.0 — source-backed palette; ≥7:1 body text and ≥4.5:1 controls.
